json_schema.title: grains.filter_by
json_schema.description: Look up the given grain in a given dictionary for the current OS and return the result

lookup_dict.ui:title: Lookup dictionary
lookup_dict.ui:description: A dictionary, keyed by a grain, containing a value or values relevant to systems matching that grain. For example, a key could be the grain for an OS and the value could the name of a package on that particular OS

grain.ui:title: Grain name
grain.ui:description: The name of a grain to match with the current system's grains. For example, the value of the "os_family" grain for the current system could be used to pull values from the lookup dictionary

merge.ui:title: Merge dictionary
merge.ui:description: A dictionary to merge with the results of the grain selection from lookup dictionary. This allows Pillar to override the values in the lookup dictionary. This could be useful, for example, to override the values for non-standard package names such as when using a different Python version from the default Python version provided by the OS (e.g., python26-mysql instead of python-mysql

default.ui:title: Default lookup dictionary key
default.ui:description: Default lookup dictionaries key used if the grain does not exists or if the grain value has no match on lookup dict. If unspecified the value is "default"

base.ui:title: Base
base.ui:description: A lookup dictionary key to use for a base dictionary. The grain-selected lookup dictionary is merged over this and then finally the merge dictionary is merged. This allows common values for each case to be collected in the base and overridden by the grain selection dictionary and the merge dictionary. Default is unset
